'''2017 European Championship''' was the Players Committee European Championship at Zu Den Vier Winden in Bochum, Germany, 8–10 September 2017. [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] finished 1st in Day 3.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-european-championships/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Bochum, Germany
* '''Dates:''' 8–10 September 2017
* '''Winner:''' [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]
